annotations.title: Page evidence pack: read, headers and signed hash

description: One call for one public URL: fetch the page as clean text, grade its HTTP security headers, and return a SHA-256 of the extracted text with a receipt naming the URL, the result hash and the payment terms, Ed25519-signed with our published key. The hash covers the text as read, not the page's raw bytes. Use when an agent needs citable evidence that a page said something at a point in time. Failures are never charged; nulls are never guesses. Example: url=https://example.com. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
